title: Commissions

{{Infobox/Generic |image=Book and Quill.png |title=Commissions }} '''Commissions''' are [[mining]] quests issued by the [[King]] and his [[Emissary|Emissaries]] that involve completing a certain task repeatedly in either the [[Dwarven Mines]] or [[Crystal Hollows]]. Completing a '''Commission''' rewards the player with {{skl|mining|XP}}, [[Heart of the Mountain]] XP and either {{Mithril Powder}}, {{Gemstone Powder}} or {{Glacite Powder}}. Completing '''Commisions''' contributes to the tiered {{ach|Hard Working Miner|ach=true}}. __TOC__ == Mechanics == Initially, players have only two commissions slots, but after completing 100 commissions, players will gain a third commission slot. Additionally, at {{coll|Heart of the Mountain 5}}, players can unlock the [[Heart of the Mountain|Core of the Mountain]] perk for a fourth slot. Commission slots 1 & 3, and 2 & 4 have the same quest pool and cannot have duplicate types of commissions. [[Crystal Hollows]] commissions are a different set of 4 commissions. They all draw from the same Commission pool, and also cannot have duplicates. === Rewards === {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center" ! !{{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} !{{zone|Crystal Hollows}} !{{zone|Glacite Tunnels}} |- !Mining XP |{{Dark Gray|5-10k}} |{{Dark Gray|10-20k}} |{{Dark Gray|12.5-25k}} |- !HotM XP |{{Dark Purple|100}} at Heart of the Mountain 1
{{Dark Purple|200}} at Heart of the Mountain 2
{{Dark Purple|400}} at Heart of the Mountain 3+
{{Dark Purple|0}} at Heart of the Mountain 10 |{{Dark Purple|400}} |{{Dark Purple|750}} |- !Powder |{{Mithril Powder|500}}
{{Mithril Powder|1,000}} at HotM 10. |{{Gemstone Powder|1,000}}
{{Gemstone Powder|2,000}} at HotM 10. |{{glacite Powder|1,500}}
{{Glacite Powder|3,000}} at HotM 10. |} ==== Daily Rewards ==== First 4 commissions every day wherever they are give {{DarkPurple|900 more HoTM XP}} until it is maxed. Once Heart of the Mountain is maxed, daily commissions give an additional {{Mithril Powder|1600}}, {{Gemstone Powder|3200}} or {{glacite Powder|4000}}. Daily bonuses are reset at midnight [https://time.is/ET Hypixel Server Time]. === Milestones === Completing a certain number of commissions rewards the player with unique items and abilities. {| class="wikitable" ! Milestone !Commissions !Rewards |- | class="ct" |{{Romnum|I}} | class="ct" |5 |{{Plainlist|*[[Emissaries|{{Gold|Emissaries}}]] *1x [[Royal Compass|{{Blue|Royal Compass}}]] *+{{DarkAqua|100,000}} [[Mining|Mining Experience]] *{{SkyBlock XP|short=y|+20}} }} |- | class="ct" |{{Romnum|II}} | class="ct" |25 |{{Plainlist|*+{{DarkAqua|200,000}} [[Mining|Mining Experience]] *{{SkyBlock XP|short=y|+30}} }} |- | class="ct" |{{Romnum|III}} | class="ct" |100 |{{Plainlist|*+{{Green|1 Commission Slot}} *+{{DarkAqua|400,000}} [[Mining|Mining Experience]] *{{SkyBlock XP|short=y|+30}} }} |- | class="ct" | {{Romnum|IV}} | class="ct" |250 |{{Plainlist|*1x [[Travel Scroll to Dwarven Mines|{{Blue|Travel Scroll to Dwarven Mines}}]] *+{{DarkAqua|800,000}} [[Mining|Mining Experience]] *{{SkyBlock XP|short=y|+50}} }} |- | class="ct" |{{Romnum|V}} | class="ct" |500 |{{Plainlist|*1x [[Royal Pigeon|{{Gold|Royal Pigeon}}]] *+{{DarkAqua|1,200,000}} [[Mining|Mining Experience]] *{{SkyBlock XP|short=y|+50}} }} |- | class="ct" |{{Romnum|VI}} | class="ct" |750 | {{Plainlist|*1x [[Travel Scroll to the Crystal Nucleus|{{Blue|Travel Scroll to the Crystal Nucleus}}]] *+{{DarkAqua|1,600,000}} [[Mining|Mining Experience]] *{{SkyBlock XP|short=y|+75}} }} |} == Commissions == === Dwarven Mines Commissions === Different '''Commissions''' are selected depending on which slot is selected. These '''Commissions''' can only be completed in the {{zone|Dwarven Mines}}. Certain '''Commissions''' require the player to mine ores in a certain area of the [[Dwarven Mines]]. This [[Location|area]] is picked at random from the following locations: *[[Cliffside Veins]] *[[Lava Springs]] *[[Rampart's Quarry]] *[[Royal Mines]] *[[Upper Mines]] Players can have multiple of those at the same times, they're listed as one in the interest of brevity. Commissions belong to one of two groups Event and Non-event. Players will always have at least {{green|1}} of each group, regardless of how many slots they have. {| class="wikitable sortable" !class="unsortable"|Name !class="unsortable"|Description !Group |- |Glacite Walker Slayer |Slay {{Green|50}} {{Red|[[Glacite Walker]]s}}. |Non-event |- |Goblin Slayer | Slay {{Green|100}} {{Red|[[Goblin]]s}}. |Non-event |- |Mithril Miner |Mine {{Green|350}} [[Mithril Ore]]. |Non-event |- |[Area] Mithril |Mine {{Green|250}} [[Mithril Ore]] in {{aqua|[area]}}. |Non-event |- | Titanium Miner |Mine {{Green|15}} [[Titanium]]. |Non-event |- |[Area] Titanium |Mine {{Green|10}} Titanium Ore in {{aqua|[area]}}. |Non-event |- |Treasure Hoarder Puncher |Damage {{Red|[[Treasure Hoarder]]s}} {{Green|10}} times. |Non-event |- |Goblin Raid |Participate in the [[Goblin Raid|{{Red|Goblin Raid}}]] event. |Event |- |Goblin Raid Slayer |Slay {{Green|20}} {{Red|Goblins}} during the [[Goblin Raid|{{Red|Goblin Raid}}]] Event. |Event |- |Elusive Goblin Slayer |Slay {{Green|1}} {{gold|[[Golden Goblin]]}} or {{aqua|[[Diamond Goblin]]}}. |Event |- |Raffle |Participate in the [[Raffle|{{Gold|Raffle}}]] Event. |Event |- |Lucky Raffle |Deposit {{Green|20}} [[Raffle Ticket]]s during the [[Raffle|{{Gold|Raffle}}]] Event. |Event |- |Star Sentry Puncher | Punch [[Star Sentry|Star Sentries]] 10 times. |Non-event |- |2x Mithril Powder Collector | Collect {{Mithril Powder|500}} during the [[2x Powder]] event. |Event |} ===== Starter ===== The player's first few commissions are slightly altered to make them easier. {| class="wikitable" !Name !Description |- |First Event |Participate in any Mining Event. |- |Mithril Miner |Mine 50/150 [[Mithril]] anywhere. |- |Titanium Miner |Mine 2 [[Titanium]] anywhere. |- |Mines Slayer |Kill {{Green|50}} Creatures in the Mines. |} For the First Event commission, [[Passive Events]] count too. The Mithril Miner commission will be {{green|50}} the first time, and {{green|150}} the second time, before becoming the usual {{green|350}}. === Crystal Hollows Commissions === These '''Commissions''' can only be completed in the {{zone|Crystal Hollows}}. Certain '''Commissions''' require the player to collect certain [[Gemstones]]. This [[Gemstones|gemstone]] is picked at random from the following ores: *[[Amber]] *[[Amethyst]] *[[Jade]] *[[Ruby]] *[[Sapphire]] *[[Topaz]] Players can have multiple of those at the same times, they're listed as one in the interest of brevity. Certain '''Commissions''' require the player to obtain a certain [[Gemstone Crystal]]. This [[Gemstone Crystals|crystal]] is picked at random from the following crystals: *[[Amber]] *[[Amethyst]] *[[Jade]] *[[Sapphire]] *[[Topaz]] Players can have multiple of those at the same times, they're listed as one in the interest of brevity. Commissions belong to one of two groups Crystal and Non-crystal. Players will always have at least {{green|1}} of each group, regardless of how many slots they have. {| class="wikitable sortable" !class="unsortable"|Commission Name !class="unsortable"|Commission Description !Group |- |[Type] Gemstone Collector |Collect {{Green|1,000}} [type] [[Gemstone]]s. |Non-crystal |- |Automaton Slayer |Slay {{Green|13}} [[Automaton]]s in the {{Aqua|Precursor Remnant}}. |Non-crystal |- |Sludge Slayer |Slay {{Green|25}} [[Sludge]]s in the {{Dark Green|Jungle}}. |Non-crystal |- |Team Treasurite Member Slayer |Slay {{Green|13}} [[Team Treasurite Member]]s in the {{Dark Green|Mithril Deposits}}. |Non-crystal |- |Goblin Slayer |Slay {{Green|13}} [[Goblins]] in the {{gold|Goblin Holdout}}. |Non-crystal |- |Yog Slayer |Slay {{Green|13}} [[Yog]]s in the {{Red|Magma Fields}}. |Non-crystal |- |Chest Looter |Open {{Green|3}} chests. |Non-crystal |- |Thyst Slayer |Slay {{Green|5}} [[Thyst|Thysts]] in the {{Dark Green|Jungle}}. |Non-crystal |- |Hard Stone Miner |Mine {{Green|1,000}} [[Hard Stone]]. |Non-crystal |- |[Gemstone] Crystal Hunter |Find a [gemstone] [[Gemstone Crystals|Crystal]] in the [area]. |Crystal |- |Boss Corleone Slayer |Slay {{Green|1}} [[Boss Corleone]] in the {{Dark Green|Mithril Deposits}}. |Crystal |} === Glacite Tunnels === These '''Commissions''' can only be completed in the {{zone|Glacite Tunnels}}. Certain '''Commissions''' require the player to collect certain [[Gemstones]] or [[Dwarven Metals]]. This is picked at random from the following: *[[Aquamarine]] *[[Citrine]] *[[Glacite]] *[[Onyx]] *[[Peridot]] *[[Tungsten]] *[[Umber]] Players can have multiple of this kind of commission. They're listed as one in the interest of brevity. Commissions belong to one of two groups Mineshaft and Non-mineshaft. Players will always have at least {{green|1}} of each group, regardless of how many slots they have. {| class="wikitable sortable" !class="unsortable"|Commission Name !class="unsortable"|Commission Description !Group |- |[Material] Collector |Collect {{Green|1,500}} [Material]. |Non-mineshaft |- |Mineshaft Explorer |Discover {{Green|1}} Mineshaft. |Mineshaft |- |Corpse Looter |Loot {{Green|2}} [[Frozen Corpses]]. |Mineshaft |- |Scrap Collector |Obtain {{Green|1}} [[Suspicious Scrap]]. |Mineshaft |- |Maniac Slayer |Slay {{Green|10}} {{Red|[[Glacite Maniacs|Maniacs]]}} in the {{Aqua|[[Glacite Mineshafts]]}}. |Mineshaft |} === Removed === {| class="wikitable" !Name !Description |- |Powder Ghast Puncher |Damage a [[Powder Ghast]] 5 times. |} == Notes == *While types of commission are no longer locked to a specific slot (for example 1st and 3rd), they are set in a way where the player will not have 4 commissions that depend on Events, obtaining Crystals or being in {{zone|Glacite Tunnels}}. *{{Ench|Compact}} and [[Heart_of_the_Mountain#Efficient_Miner|Efficient Miner]] perk work for speeding up commissions and calculates the total raw material amount. *{{stat|Pristine}} works for speeding up commissions but only counting the Flawed Gemstone drops as individual drops rather than the raw x80 per Flawed. == Trivia == *While the {{Skill|Mining|XP}} gained from milestones is not boosted by any experience multipliers, the one obtained from Commissions themselves is. This makes them an effective way to level pets, especially within the {{zone|Glacite Tunnels}} where all commissions can be done near one another and require no prep time. *If you kill a large {{MobSprite|Sludge}} which then splits into smaller Sludges, the large one and the small ones all count as individual kills for the '''Sludge Slayer''' commission. == History == {{History table |beta=
